test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Which of the following is NOT a correct statement about the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis?

options.text: They power the synthesis of ATP and NADPH.
The energy from sunlight is absorbed by pigments in the chloroplasts of plant cell.
They convert water into oxygen and high-energy electrons.
They use energy from sunlight to produce glucose.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis do not produce glucose directly.
 
• Instead, they generate ATP and NADPH, which are used in the light-independent reactions (Calvin cycle) to produce glucose.
 
• These reactions occur in the thylakoid membranes of the chloroplast and involve the absorption of sunlight by pigments like chlorophyll.
 
• Water molecules are split, releasing oxygen as a byproduct and producing high-energy electrons.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Correct – The light-dependent reactions generate ATP and NADPH, which are energy-rich molecules.
 
• **Option 2:** Correct – Sunlight is absorbed by pigments in the chloroplasts to drive these reactions.
 
• **Option 3:** Correct – Water is split into oxygen and high-energy electrons during this stage.
